name: Castilla y León
shape: Eurostat NUTS, the area it is named for

blurb.text: A Spanish PGI in the Vino de la Tierra (IGP) category, whose vineyards are dominated by Tempranillo, which makes up half of plantings. Verdejo is second at 23 percent, followed by smaller shares of Mencía, Garnacha and Prieto Picudo.
